verdict.rationale: Postman is an API platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. A probe confirms an official Postman MCP server is documented at postman.com/postman-mcp-server, and adjacent docs show broader MCP investment: an MCP Generator for building servers from Postman API Network APIs, and a gateway for registering MCP servers. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the official server's tools and capabilities, setup and auth instructions for connecting agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
